blocks.observation: In new band1, the small separated upper branching bodies at1500 become a broad dense upper lattice and an extended lower-middle branched cluster at2000. In new band0, the large lower-left mesh at1500 clears almost completely by2000, leaving separated small branches and large empty gaps. This is increased occupied structure and clearance in the same qualifying interval, independent of hue.
blocks.historicalComparison: Historical alternating also expands its band1 upper/lower lattice and clears most band0 bodies in this interval; this screen occurs under both rules.

blocks.observation: New band0 changes from a few isolated central branches to a much larger connected-looking concentration of occupied branches across its middle/lower region. New band1 loses the broad upper lattice seen at2000, opening a large upper gap and retaining a smaller middle/lower assembly at2500. Connected appearance is visual only, not evidence of an independently reproducing colony.
blocks.historicalComparison: Historical world at2500 has only scattered short branches in both bands, unlike the much denser new middle-band occupied clusters.

blocks.observation: New band0 loses most of its large middle/lower assembly, leaving two small occupied clusters. New band1 rearranges into a long lower vertical branch and separated upper branches, but does not show net majority growth; its occupied count falls40. This block fails and is not relabeled successful.
blocks.historicalComparison: Historical world recovers visibly in both bands by3000; its band1 upper lattice and dispersed lower clusters differ from the new thinner lower vertical structure.

ownWorld2500To3000.observation: The large central/lower occupied concentration in band0 at2500 is mostly absent at3000. In band1 the middle dense branching assembly gives way to a long lower vertical occupied structure plus separated upper branches; this is a concrete occupied-body rearrangement, although the seasonal numerical growth criterion fails for this block.

scope: Manual descriptive screen only; food shading, IDs, borders and color alone were not used as passing evidence. No adaptation, migration, causal superiority or general fitness claim.
